title: CrossProjection: Benchmarking Spatial Grounding across Projection and Section Views
abstract: arXiv:2608.00473v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Plans, elevations, and sections describe a three-dimensional structure through incomplete projections that change how an entity is drawn, not only where it is seen from. Reading them means deciding which entities correspond across views and recovering where they lie. We introduce CrossProjection, a benchmark that uses architectural drawings to test whether vision-language models (VLMs) can turn correspondence decisions into geometric answers. Its tasks cover cross-view matching, projection registration, and novel-section prediction, with outputs ranging from judgments and candidate selection to free region boxes and directed section cuts. For inverse section localization, we introduce, to our knowledge, the first VLM benchmark protocol that accepts any cut within an expert-adjudicated band of compatible positions and checks the viewing direction separately. translated_title: CrossProjection：跨投影图与剖面图的空间定位基准测试
translated_abstract: 平面图、立面图和剖面图通过不完整的投影来描述三维结构，这些投影不仅改变了观察实体的视角，也改变了实体被绘制的方式。阅读这些图纸意味着判断哪些实体在不同视图之间相互对应，并恢复它们所处的位置。我们提出了CrossProjection，这是一个使用建筑图纸来测试视觉语言模型（VLM）能否将对应关系决策转化为几何答案的基准。其任务涵盖跨视图匹配、投影配准和新剖面预测，输出形式从判断和候选选择到自由区域框和有向剖面切线。对于逆向剖面定位，据我们所知，我们引入了首个VLM基准协议，该协议接受专家裁定的兼容位置带内的任意切线，并单独检查观察方向。人工标注的图纸和BIM导出的视图提供了33,788个问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了CrossProjection基准，利用建筑图纸测试视觉语言模型在跨视图匹配、投影配准和新剖面预测等空间定位任务上的能力，并首次引入了接受专家裁定的兼容位置带内任意剖面切线的逆向剖面定位评估协议。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CrossProjection, a benchmark using architectural drawings to test whether vision-language models can turn cross-view correspondence decisions into geometric answers across matching, registration, and section prediction tasks, featuring the first VLM protocol for inverse section localization that accepts any cut within an expert-adjudicated band of compatible positions.
